word-cherry.def: a small round red fruit with a hard stone inside and a long stem

word-peach.def: a soft round fruit with fuzzy orange-pink skin and a large stone

word-plum.def: a small round purple or red fruit with smooth skin and a stone

word-watermelon.def: a very large round fruit with green skin, red juicy flesh and black seeds

word-melon.def: a large round sweet fruit with soft pale flesh and many seeds inside

word-pineapple.def: a tropical fruit with rough skin, sharp leaves on top and sweet yellow flesh

word-mango.def: a sweet tropical fruit with orange flesh and a large flat stone

word-kiwi.def: a small fruit with fuzzy brown skin and green flesh with tiny black seeds

word-apricot.def: a small round orange fruit, softer than a peach, with a smooth stone

word-raspberry.def: a small soft red berry made of many tiny round parts

word-pomegranate.def: a round fruit with hard red skin and many juicy red seeds inside

word-avocado.def: a green fruit with creamy flesh and one large round stone

word-cabbage.def: a large round vegetable with thick green or purple leaves packed tightly together

word-bell-pepper.def: a hollow, crunchy vegetable in red, yellow or green that tastes mild, not hot

word-eggplant.def: a large vegetable with shiny dark purple skin and soft white flesh

word-zucchini.def: a long, thin, dark green summer vegetable with soft flesh

word-broccoli.def: a green vegetable with a thick stem and small tree-shaped heads

word-lettuce.def: a vegetable with soft green leaves, eaten raw in salads and sandwiches

word-spinach.def: a vegetable with dark green leaves that can be eaten raw or cooked

word-peas.def: small round green seeds that grow in pods and are eaten as a vegetable

word-beans.def: seeds, or seed pods, of certain plants, cooked and eaten as food

word-corn.def: a tall plant with large yellow kernels on a cob, eaten as a vegetable

word-pumpkin.def: a large round orange vegetable with thick skin, used for soup, pies and Halloween

word-beet.def: a round dark red root vegetable, often used in salads and soups

word-olive.def: a small green or black fruit that is eaten whole or pressed to make oil

word-herbs.def: leafy plants such as basil or mint that add flavor to food

word-parsley.def: a green herb with small curly or flat leaves, used to flavor and decorate food

word-dill.def: a thin green herb with a strong fresh smell, often used with fish and pickles

word-ginger.def: a spicy yellow root used in cooking and in tea

word-cereal.def: a crunchy food made from grain, eaten with milk at breakfast

word-porridge.def: a thick hot breakfast made by boiling crushed grain in milk or water

word-buckwheat.def: a small brown seed that is cooked like rice or ground into flour

word-bread-roll.def: a small round baked loaf for one person

word-toast.def: slices of bread heated until crisp and brown

word-dumplings.def: small pieces of dough filled with meat or vegetables, boiled or steamed

word-pancake.def: a thin flat round cake of batter fried in a pan

word-tofu.def: a soft white food made from soybeans, popular in vegetarian cooking

word-soy-sauce.def: a salty dark liquid made from fermented beans, used in Asian cooking

word-vinegar.def: a sour liquid made from wine or fruit, used on salads and for pickling

word-ketchup.def: a sweet red sauce made from tomatoes, eaten with fries and burgers

word-mustard.def: a yellow or brown sauce with a sharp taste, eaten with meat and hot dogs

word-cream.def: the thick, rich, white part of milk, used in desserts and coffee

word-sour-cream.def: a thick, tangy white dairy product served with baked potatoes and soup

word-cottage-cheese.def: a soft, white, lumpy dairy food with a mild taste, made from curdled milk

word-lamb-meat.def: the meat of a young sheep, eaten as food

word-turkey-meat.def: the meat of a large farm bird, traditionally eaten at Thanksgiving and Christmas

word-ham.def: salted pork from the leg of a pig, often cut in thin slices

word-bacon.def: thin salty strips of pork, fried until crisp, often eaten at breakfast

word-steak.def: a thick flat slice of beef, usually grilled or fried

word-minced-meat.def: beef or pork chopped into tiny pieces by a machine, used for burgers and sauces

word-salmon.def: a large pink fish that lives in the sea and swims up rivers

word-tuna.def: a large sea fish, often sold in cans

word-shrimp.def: a small sea animal with a curved body and a soft shell, eaten as food

word-seafood.def: fish and other animals from the sea that people eat

word-sushi.def: a Japanese food of cold rice with raw fish or vegetables

word-burger.def: a flat round piece of cooked ground beef served in a bun

word-french-fries.def: thin sticks of potato cooked in hot oil

word-omelet.def: eggs beaten together and cooked flat in a pan, often folded over a filling

word-stew.def: a dish of meat and vegetables cooked slowly in liquid

word-barbecue.def: food cooked over an open fire outdoors, or a party where it is served

word-curry.def: a dish of meat or vegetables cooked in a spicy sauce, often served with rice

word-pie.def: a baked dish with a crust of pastry and a sweet or savory filling

word-mineral-water.def: a bottled drink from a natural spring, often with bubbles

word-lemonade.def: a sweet, sour cold drink made from squeezed yellow citrus fruit, sugar and water

word-cocktail.def: a mixed alcoholic drink, often served in a fancy glass

word-vodka.def: a strong clear alcoholic drink, originally from Russia and Poland

word-cocoa.def: a sweet hot drink made from dark brown powder and milk

word-portion.def: an amount of food for one person at a meal

word-takeaway.def: food that you buy at a restaurant and eat somewhere else

word-food-delivery.def: a service that brings meals from restaurants to your home

word-vegan.def: not eating or using any animal products, such as meat, eggs or milk

word-gluten-free.def: made without wheat, barley or rye, for people who cannot eat them

word-organic.def: grown or made without artificial chemicals

word-calorie.def: a unit that measures the energy in food

word-vitamin.def: a natural substance in food that your body needs to stay healthy

word-diet.def: the food and drink a person usually has, or a special eating plan

word-slice.def: a thin flat piece cut from bread, cheese or cake

word-jar.def: a glass container with a lid, used for storing food

word-picnic.def: a meal eaten outdoors, often in a park

word-butcher-shop.def: a store that sells fresh meat

word-grocery-store.def: a store that sells food and small household items

word-sobremesa.gl: sobremesa: Spanish custom of staying at the table to chat after a meal

word-aperitivo.gl: aperitivo: Italian early-evening drink served with snacks at a bar

word-fika.gl: fika: Swedish social break for coffee and pastries with friends or colleagues

word-nhau.gl: nhậu: Vietnamese social drinking of beer or spirits with shared food
